column1: # German plural lexicon: singular (lowercase) <TAB> nominative plural (lowercase).
# Loaded by VariableReplacers.de.cs (LoadPlurals). Covers every non-plural noun of
# GenderLexicon.tsv plus frequent item/creature nouns. Real-umlaut AND folded
# (ae/oe/ue/ss) spellings. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Omitted (no usual plural): gold, silber, kupfer, blut, fleisch, laub, mark (n), wut.
